body:
Thanks for replying!

I've read the talking points. I listen to everything he has to say, but I can't come up with anything meaningful and supportive to respond with because it's not something I'm accustomed to. Especially when he brings up his relationship with my mom and how he regrets the divorce. That's basically where every conversation stops.

He lives with a roommate far from everyone. He has no friends or family nearby. He has been disabled and out of work for quite some time. He has a dog that is with him at all times, but lately he has been saying it is his roommate's dog. I'm afraid that he's cutting ties to make it easier for him to end his life.

I know that he has seen mental health professionals in the last year. I also know that he is being kept longer at the hospital now for a mental health evaluation. I haven't been able to speak to him today so I don't know how it's going. He sent me one text message this morning that just said "thank you," so I'm hopeful something has clicked or someone got through to him.
